prose: Google Labs introduces Tabletop as a shared space where groups add links, files and ideas, then generate interactive planning tools. Its examples include itineraries, polls, expense splitters and tournament brackets that participants can use at the same time. The announcement describes a US waitlist rollout for adults, not general global availability.
highlights: Inputs include links, files and ideas
Examples include polls and expense splitters
Invite links bring groups into one workspace
US adult waitlist limits the announced rollout
